summary: Banner container section for organizing multiple banners with responsive layouts.
shortDescription: The Banner Container section is specifically optimized for organizing promotional banners in grid arrangements. While similar to the general Container, it focuses on banner-specific use cases like promotional grids, feature highlights, or CTA collections. Column counts for mobile and desktop are set independently, and content alignment (left, center, right) positions banners within their cells. Background color options with theme presets create visual grouping. Ideal for homepage promotional areas or marketing campaign displays.
